title: ketchup sdk
description:
Multi-chain dApps constitute a small fraction of the total dApp ecosystem. Interoperabilty is at the cusp of adoption, but mere value transfer is not going to bring it to the masses - a thriving interchain ecosystem will. Similarly, there are a high number of new gaming networks being launched, but a lower proportion of new games. The time for accelerating product shipping is here.

1. Access: ketchup SDK democratizes multi-chain dApp development by requiring no coding knowledge

2. Cost-effectiveness: Cross-chain solutions are still within a niche and developers are catching up to it. builders with amazing ideas for cross-chain dApps have difficulty finding devs who can build within this niche, and when they do, are unable to afford them. Our open source tool bridges this gap.
